notes.title: Update v1.1.6
notes.notes: [h1]Patch Notes Update v1.1.6 [/h1][p]Hi there, here are some minor updates to Slumbering Feline~[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Momo can now aim and attack while climbing.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334215/a4c492f1a25186359caefa03163e029ae65a708d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Momo can now parry while climbing.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334215/009587e80aacc44440ff57f93b3bfd40327f0eeb.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Updated Xbox Controller support[/b]: attacks can now be performed with [b]LT[/b] or [b]RT[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334215/8b9e917aa656b532c9cdc74937e7a589464e9a19.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added an additional visual enemy link[/b] that shows above the foreground to help spot hidden enemies.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334215/28bd47e101dbe082e96dcd2ab30b742caf0699e6.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added new difficulty presets[/b] in the early game to help players adjust the challenge:[/p][list][*][p][b]Normal[/b]: Obstacles rise with their true strength, just as the world was meant to be.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Casual[/b]: Challenges feel softer, giving you more room to explore and enjoy the journey[/p][/*][*][p][i]These are only presets; you can still manually adjust enemy HP and damage at any time.[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334215/bd0a41d8e5853f1d31ace6a280e8dd7aa02d94c0.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed menu [b]“Assist Mode”[/b] into [b]“Difficulty”.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Star Stone now plays an animation.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334215/1e0feea64e4256f1210b2175586ef1e8dd0dff91.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some [b]visual issues with Xbox Controller[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Enemies[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Respawn times increased by +5s across all enemies[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Adjusted aggressive enemies[/b]: reduced slow factor, slightly increased damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted [b]slow factor[/b] for some enemies.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Other[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Improved the escape door dialogue[/b]. [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Enjoy the weekend~[/p]

notes.title: Update v1.1.1
notes.notes:
We heard you!

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[h3]QoL: New Hold & Release Attack Control[/h3]
- Momo can instantly attack by hold and release [b][Attack][/b] button
- Holding [b][Attack][/b] will instantly open [b]Aim Mode[/b]
- Release [b][Attack][/b] will release Attack and close [b]Aim Mode[/b]
- When Holding [b][Attack][/b] Player can press [b][Open/Close Aim][/b] to cancel [b]attack[/b] and close [b]Aim Mode[/b]
- By default, [b][Attack][/b] bindings are [b]Left Mouse [/b] in keyboard & mouse and [b]A/RT[/b] in Xbox Controller.
- Tips using Xbox Controller: Use [b]RT[/b] to holding & release and [b]Right Analog[/b] to aiming direction for better experience.
- Previous control (Manually Open-Close Aim Mode) and new control can be use together
- [b][Interaction][/b] also change using separate button [b]F[/b] in Keyboard & Mouse and [b]X[/b] in Xbox Controller

[url=https://x.com/TheFlavare/status/1905681295692247392][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334215/8783e364c3ef1c1457e96fafe52ec160a9029e88.gif[/img][/url]
[url=https://x.com/TheFlavare/status/1905681295692247392][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334215/8701e1b9ff1d869221c400c9c37ecfebbadca0b4.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Assist Mode[/h3]
- Player now can casual play with this new Assist Mode
- Assist Mode can be access from Pause Game - Options Menu
- Assist Mode also saved when game is saved.
- Available option: Enemy HP from 100% (Default) up to 20%
- Available option: Enemy Damage from 100% (Default) up to 20%

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334215/f91a0f1c884e68eebcf2ba05c88b108cbd2a9e2d.png[/img]

[h3]Interaction[/h3]
- [b][Interaction][/b] now has separate control using [b]F[/b] in Keyboard & Mouse and [b]X[/b] in Xbox Controller to avoid conflict with New Hold & Release Attack Control

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334215/5f358802fb711aa2f650c6a2e66ea2a1fac7055b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334215/44bea4b5b7efdc749bfead136c704698107d1db6.png[/img]

[h2]Adjustment & Improvement[/h2]
- Increase respawn time for all enemies by 1-3s
- Adjust Damage on Touch for non-aggressive enemies by little bit higher
- Reduce HP for non-aggressive enemies by ~20%
- Added HP Regeneration for all enemies after not damaged for 5s by 1/s (Except the Huge enemies)
- little improve Loading speed

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
- Hide Continue button that sometime appear on fresh new game in Main Menu
- Fix Inconsistently enemy linked link not disappear when the game restarted after kill the Huge enemies and get the Stone-key item (It should be disappear after kill and get the Stone-key item)
- Various translation fixes
